gold_label_policy_description: dataset label 1.0 counts as INCLUDE; 0.5 and 0.0 count as EXCLUDE

studies.study_title: Treatment of FIGO (1971) stage 1 endometrial carcinoma with intensive surgery, radiotherapy and hormonotherapy according to pathological prognostic groups. Long term results of a randomised multicentre trial
studies.predicted_reason: Multicentre RCT evaluating adjuvant medroxyprogesterone acetate (a progestagen) following surgery for stage I endometrial carcinoma. Meets all selection criteria: RCT design, post-surgical population, and progestagen intervention.

studies.study_title: Progestin therapy of endometrial, breast and ovarian carcinoma. A review of clinical observations.
studies.predicted_reason: This is a narrative review and survey of the literature, not a primary randomised controlled trial. It does not report original RCT data of progestagen therapy after surgery for endometrial cancer.
Methodology paper concerning statistical inconsistency in meta-analyses. Not an RCT and does not report clinical data on progestagen therapy for endometrial cancer.

studies.study_title: Statistical methods for examining heterogeneity and combining results from several studies in meta‐analysis
studies.predicted_reason: Methodology chapter on meta-analysis statistical techniques. Not a clinical trial and contains no patient-level data on progestagen therapy after surgery.

studies.study_title: A randomised trial of adjuvant progestagens in early endometrial cancer
studies.predicted_reason: Randomised controlled trial directly comparing adjuvant progestagen therapy with no additional therapy after surgery in patients with Stage I or II endometrial cancer. Fully meets selection criteria.
Methodology paper discussing random-effects approaches to combining evidence across trials. Not a primary RCT and does not report data on progestagen therapy for endometrial cancer.

studies.study_title: A randomised trial of progestagens in the primary treatment of endometrial carcinoma
studies.predicted_reason: Randomised trial of progestagen versus control in women with endometrial carcinoma treated with surgery (all patients post-operation). Meets the RCT criterion and involves progestagen therapy in a post-surgical population.

studies.study_title: Extracting summary statistics to perform meta‐analyses of the published literature for survival endpoints
studies.predicted_reason: Methodology paper on extracting statistics for survival meta-analyses. Not a clinical trial and provides no primary data on progestagen therapy after surgery for endometrial cancer.

studies.study_title: Aduvant progesterone therapy for stage 1 endometrial cancer
studies.predicted_reason: Controlled trial comparing adjuvant hydroxyprogesterone versus placebo after total abdominal hysterectomy for stage I endometrial cancer. The parallel placebo-controlled design with balanced allocation strongly suggests an RCT, though randomisation is not explicitly stated in the abstract. Included conservatively pending full-text verification.

studies.study_title: Adjuvant progestagen therapy improves survival in patients with endometrial cancer after hysterectomy. results of one‐institutional prospective clinical trial
studies.predicted_reason: Prospective institutional clinical trial with random assignment to adjuvant progestagen or no additional therapy after surgery for endometrial cancer. Meets RCT and population/intervention criteria.
